from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Full-width horizontal bands encode a repeating row pattern.
    bands = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
             if row[0] != 0 and all(value == row[0] for value in row)]
    if bands:
        period = len(bands)
        colors = {r % period: color for r, color in bands}
        return [[colors[r % period] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

    # Otherwise, parallel down-right diagonals encode a repeating diagonal pattern.
    diagonals = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, color in enumerate(row):
            if color:
                d = r - c
                diagonals[d] = color
    period = len(diagonals)
    colors = {d % period: color for d, color in diagonals.items()}
    return [[colors[(r - c) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
program_path=program_dir/'task-a18cae23.py'
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path)
